title: Money with operators
hints: Each operator is a small `impl` with `type Output = Money;` (except `AddAssign`, which changes `self`) (lesson 8.02).
For `Display`, print the sign yourself and then the absolute value: `p / 100` pounds and `p % 100` pence with `{:02}`.

For `FromStr`, split off an optional `-` with `strip_prefix('-')` and the pence with `split_once('.')`, then check that each part is made of digits only: `part.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())` (or `matches!(c, '0'..='9')`). Checking first matters, because `parse::<i64>()` alone would also accept text such as `+5`.
